title: Stuffed peppers with turkey mince and rice
steps: Pre-cook the rice according to the packet. Preheat the oven to 190 °C.
Chop the onion and garlic, sweat them in the oil, fry the mince until crumbly and season with paprika, oregano, salt and pepper.
Mix in the rice and 100 ml passata.
Halve and deseed the peppers, fill them and place in a dish with the remaining passata.
Top with mozzarella, bake covered for 25 minutes and uncovered for 10 minutes, and serve with parsley.
